security_findings.finding: Stale plan invalidation is purely client-side React state (staleMessageIds Set); there is no server/backend guarantee that an old plan cannot still be executed if approved through another code path.
security_findings.scenario: If a future integration re-renders PlanCard outside ChatScreen's state ownership (e.g. optimistic update from a websocket event that recreates the message list without preserving staleMessageIds), a stale plan could regain an enabled approve button. Already flagged as an accepted risk in atdd.md (Risks section) and out of scope for #264.

security_findings.finding: editingPlanMessageId is a single scalar, not per-message; clicking "Planı değiştir" on plan B while plan A's edit is still pending silently overwrites the target without any visual indication of which plan is currently being edited.
security_findings.scenario: User edits plan A, gets distracted, clicks 'değiştir' on plan B, types a correction meant for A and sends — only B is marked stale, A remains approvable. Matches the ATDD's own documented assumption (single editingPlanMessageId), a known scoped tradeoff not a new bug.

alternative_approach.recommended_direction: Extract editingPlanMessageId/staleMessageIds/draft interplay into a small reducer or custom hook to make the invariant explicit and testable in isolation, before saga #265/#266/#267 add real backend re-plan wiring on top.
files_that_should_change: ui/src/components/chat/ChatScreen.tsx — consider a useChatEditingState reducer hook (forward-looking, not a blocker)
ui/src/components/chat/PlanCard.tsx — consider aria-describedby linking the hint to the textarea for stronger a11y (forward-looking, not a blocker)
alternative_approach.rationale: Not required for #264; noted for future tasks that build on this state.

approved_points: onChangePlan is fully decoupled from onApprove — verified no shared code path (AC-1 satisfied, test asserts onApprove not called).
Stale precedence in statusText correctly overrides both rejected and pending states (behaviour-contract row 4).
Empty-message guard preserved: sendDraft() still no-ops on empty draft before any stale-marking (AC/behaviour-contract row 2, tested).
canApprove correctly ANDs in !stale — stale plan's approve button permanently disabled, no bypass via re-render.
verify_report.md shows 68/68 tests passing across 5 files, consistent with code_diff.md/test_diff.md.
overall_assessment: Diff matches claims, satisfies all 5 ATDD acceptance criteria, 68/68 tests green. No security/correctness regressions. Two low-severity findings are already-acknowledged scope tradeoffs, not defects.
